 2nd phase census 2027 population enumeration training held in Meluri
 November 20, 2026 
 DIMAPUR: The second batch of the second phase of Population Enumeration training for Supervisors and Enumerators from Phokhungri, Lephori Circle and Phor commenced at the DB’s Court, Deputy Commissioner’s office Meluri, on Thursday. The three-day training programme will continue until November 21.
According to a DIPR report, addressing the inaugural session, EAC and charge officer Zuchibemo Ezung, underscored the importance of conducting accurate and comprehensive household enumeration for the successful implementation of Census 2027.
He advised enumerators to make repeated visits to households where members were unavailable during the first visit to ensure that no household is left out of the census process. Stressing effective communication, Ezung urged the trainees to explain the purpose and details of the census in languages that respondents can easily understand.
Describing supervisors as the backbone of enumerators, he encouraged them to provide guidance and support in resolving challenges encountered during fieldwork. He also reminded the trainees that enumerators serve as the face of Census 2027 in Meluri district and play a crucial role in ensuring the success of the national exercise.
Ezung further encouraged the participants to seek assistance from field trainers and charge officers whenever required and wished them a productive and successful training programme.
